records.body:
Hi Sofia,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Labs!
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Following up on our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call on Monday. I wanted to check in before things get busy again.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
